title: Trump administration can’t scrap plan to move FBI headquarters to Md., judge rules
description: The administration sought to keep the agency’s headquarters in Washington.

title: Planned Parenthood to spend more than $600,000 against Susan Collins in Maine
description: The ad buy, which will focus on the senator’s vote to confirm Justice Brett M. Kavanaugh, is the largest investment from Planned Parenthood Votes in any state this cycle.

title: Justice Department plans to send about 1,000 monitors to the polls this fall
description: The move to send 1,000 poll monitors is likely the largest number under a Republican president, a DOJ official said.

title: U.S. Navy destroyer lost power for 4 days in South China Sea
description: The ship’s crew lost access last month to drinkable water, running toilets and air conditioning, as the fleet sees heavy use by the Trump administration.

title: 60 days after signing Iran deal, Trump stuck in quagmire as war drags on
description: President Donald Trump’s interim deal with Iran in June set aside two months for negotiations, but the window has now closed and broader talks are at a standstill.

title: Hegseth travels to Iowa in his ‘personal capacity’ amid 2028 speculation
description: Officials familiar with the defense secretary’s thinking believe he is considering a run for president or some other office after his time in the Trump administration ends.

title: House ethics panel investigates Rep. Jimmy Gomez over sexual misconduct allegations
description: The California Democrat said that he had “made personal mistakes outside my marriage” and that he will cooperate with the investigation.

title: Trump defends his move to cut back U.S.-South Korea military exercises
description: A day after attributing the decision to a good relationship with North Korea, President Donald Trump also tied the move to South Korea’s refusal to help with the Strait of Hormuz.

title: Teen lifeguard, who saved child from dangerous surf, meets with Trump
description: First-year lifeguard Ryder Williams, 16, said in the Oval Office that he hopes his actions inspire others to "look out for everybody around you."

title: Supreme Court asked to hear case on Texas law requiring Ten Commandments in schools
description: The case could set up a landmark clash over the separation of church and state.

title: Florida GOP race draws accusations of carpetbagging
description: "Carpetbagger" describes people who move somewhere to run for office. In Southwest Florida, six former congressional hopefuls from other states are taking their shot in this conservative stronghold.

title: Former federal prosecutor is suing DOJ for 'unlawful and retaliatory' firing
description: A federal prosecutor who was fired earlier this year is suing the DOJ, alleging she was unlawfully dismissed for political reasons tied to her work prosecuting a case against anti-abortion activists.

title: Supreme Court rebuffs Trump’s bid to overturn $5 million verdict in Carroll case
description: The president was found liable of sexually abusing and defaming E. Jean Carroll in the high-profile civil case.

title: Democratic Rep. Jimmy Gomez being investigated over sexual misconduct allegations
description: The California Democrat has admitted to "personal mistakes" outside his marriage but also says his actions were consensual in nature and did not violate House ethics rules.

title: Trump blames vandals for dead grass on lawn where he held Fourth of July event
description: Similarly damaged grass was seen at the White House Ellipse and South Lawn after the UFC Freedom 250 events this summer.

title: Cassidy on Trump’s vaccine overhaul: ‘Crazy, stupid thing’
description: Sen. Bill Cassidy blasted President Donald Trump's recent executive order that calls for unbundling the childhood MMR vaccine into three individual shots.

title: Want to know what people really think? Get the Pollwatcher newsletter.
description: Pollster Scott Clement will explore what polls reveal about the big issues shaping people’s lives across culture, technology, the economy and politics.

title: Hakeem Jeffries says he wants to see  ‘dramatic reform’ of Supreme Court
description: Hakeem Jeffries supports aggressive changes to the Supreme Court.

title: Under new Florida maps, a White Democrat aims to win a heavily Black district
description: Debbie Wasserman Schultz is competing in a racially thorny primary in which everyone seems to think experience is important — but they don’t agree on what kind.

title: DHS defends investigating agency critics and giving them warning notices
description: Federal officials acknowledged that ICE special agents tracked a New York man to his house, the airport and a hotel to question him about a critical email he sent to the former head of ICE in January.

title: So what is attracting voters to DSA’s ‘Sexy Socialist Summer’?
description: Democratic Socialists of America-endorsed or aligned candidates have won a number of Democratic primaries up and down the ballot this cycle.

title: Sen. Mark Kelly says USS Lincoln sailors 'can't get basic needs met'
description: NPR's Sacha Pfeiffer talks with Democratic Sen. Mark Kelly of Arizona about conditions aboard the USS Lincoln and his calls for an investigation into sailors' treatment.

title: Advocates worry new bans on student IDs will trip up younger voters
description: New bans on using student IDs for voting in Indiana and New Hampshire have sparked lawsuits after creating the latest hurdles to the ballot box for the U.S. voting-age group least likely to vote.

title: Trump reduces military exercises with South Korea, citing good ties with Kim Jong Un
description: The president cited the cost of the drills and said he did not want to send a signal that is "totally inappropriate and hostile" to North Korea. He also criticized South Korea for not helping him on Iran.

title: Navy weighs major warship redesign to match Trump’s preferences
description: The president wants the new fleet of aircraft carriers to more resemble those from World War II. Such a change could cost billions.

title: Trump says White House needs ‘military complex’ as courts block his ballroom
description: When Trump first unveiled his plans for the new East Wing addition, he said it was needed to host VIP guests. More recently, he is calling it a “desperately needed National Security structure.”

title: Blanche on whether DOJ will be independent: ‘I’m not going to pledge that’
description: The newly sworn-in attorney general rejected the idea of an independent Justice Department, lent support to Jeanine Pirro and declared the “anti-weaponization” fund dead.

title: Angry at the Supreme Court, liberals push a slew of plans for overhauling it
description: As the midterms near, Democrats are proposing adding more justices, limiting their terms and more.

title: Senate hopeful Talarico touts his faith. Texas Republicans call it blasphemy.
description: The Democratic nominee is seeking to win over faith-based voters in Texas, the Bible Belt’s largest state, but evangelical Republicans aren’t sold.

title: 'What are we going to do?' The mom of a trans teen grapples with Trump's Medicaid move
description: A longtime Republican living in California says the Trump administration's continuing actions to target transgender youth take a personal toll.

title: In Florida, Congressman Byron Donalds' seat is up for grabs for Republicans
description: In southwest Florida, ten Republicans are vying for the nomination to replace Rep. Byron Donalds. With the majority of candidates from outside the state - it's raising questions about representation.

title: Polls everywhere in primary season. Can they be trusted?
description: How reliable are political polls right now? NPR's Danielle Kurtzleben speaks to G. Elliott Morris from the data-driven news website, Strength In Numbers.

title: Politics chat: Democrats take lessons from the primaries, set 2028 calendar
description: We look at how the Democrats are gearing up for the 2028 presidential primaries, as well as their takeaways from the current batch of primary races.
